question: Refer to the exhibit. An engineer must invoke a Python script that alerts the operations team when the router DC-RTR-1 becomes unreachable. Which configuration set accomplishes this task?
context:
Topology: DC-RTR-1 (10.19.31.1) connects to N9K-DC-1-SPINE-1 (10.19.31.2) and N9K-DC-1-SPINE-2 (10.19.31.3).
switch(config)# ip sla 10
switch(config-ip-sla)# icmp-echo 10.19.31.1
switch(config)# ip sla schedule 10 life forever start-time now
switch(config)# track 5 ip sla 10 reachability
